description: Pathirage Don Abeyratne v. Gamage Don Chandradasa Pathirage Don Abeyratne v. Gamage Don Chandradasa View More before Hon. K.T. Chitrasiri, J.
parties: Pathirage Don Abeyratne v. Gamage Don Chandradasa Pathirage Don Abeyratne v. Gamage Don Chandradasa View More
keywords: Plaintiff claimed damages for malicious prosecution following acquittal on a contempt of court charge arising from the Defendant’s police complaint. Held - Acquittal alone does not establish malicious prosecution; plaintiff must also prove the complaint was false, instituted maliciously without reasonable cause, and that the defendant set the law in motion; as the charges were filed solely by the police nearly three and a half years after the complaint, and no wrongful intent (animus injuriandi) was established, Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; General Law of Delict
